using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class GarnetServerMonitorTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CleanupGlobalStats_LogsResettingCommandStats_WhenResetCommandStatsFlagIsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockServer = new Mock<IGarnetServer>();
            var mockGarnetServerBase = new Mock<GarnetServerBase>();
            var mockRespServerSession = new Mock<RespServerSession>();

            // Setup servers array with one mock server castable to GarnetServerBase
            IGarnetServer[] servers = new IGarnetServer[] { mockGarnetServerBase.Object };

            // Setup ActiveConsumers to return a list with one RespServerSession
            mockGarnetServerBase.Setup(s => s.ActiveConsumers()).Returns(new List<object> { mockRespServerSession.Object });

            // Setup GetCommandStats to return a mock CommandStats with Reset method
            var mockCommandStats = new Mock<CommandStats>();
            mockRespServerSession.Setup(s => s.GetCommandStats).Returns(mockCommandStats.Object);

            // Setup Reset methods on CommandStats to be verifiable
            mockCommandStats.Setup(cs => cs.Reset()).Verifiable();

            // Setup globalMetrics with non-null globalCommandStats and historyCommandStats
            var opts = new GarnetServerOptions { MetricsSamplingFrequency = 1, LatencyMonitor = false, CommandStatsMonitor = true };
            var storeWrapper = new StoreWrapper(null, null, null);
            var monitor = new GarnetServerMonitor(storeWrapper, opts, servers, mockLogger.Object);

            // Set the resetEventFlags COMMANDSTATS to true to trigger the code path
            monitor.resetEventFlags[InfoMetricsType.COMMANDSTATS] = true;

            // Set globalMetrics fields to non-null CommandStats to verify Reset calls
            var globalMetricsField = typeof(GarnetServerMonitor).GetField("globalMetrics", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var globalMetrics = (GarnetServerMetrics)globalMetricsField.GetValue(monitor);
            globalMetrics.globalCommandStats = new CommandStats();
            globalMetrics.historyCommandStats = new CommandStats();
            globalMetricsField.SetValue(monitor, globalMetrics);

            // Act
            // Call private method CleanupGlobalStats via reflection
            var method = typeof(GarnetServerMonitor).GetMethod("CleanupGlobalStats", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            method.Invoke(monitor, null);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Resetting command stats")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
